scientific_integrity: Theorem justified analytically using Poisson-Charlier expansions, Fourier overlap identities and one-dependent CLT; standalone deterministic tests only corroborate finite identities.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional Poisson marginals; deterministic positive bounded one-periodic intensity, unit-width windows and physical-time averaging only. The strict-optimality statement does not address arbitrary sampling clock, non-Poisson targets, or coupled multivariate processes; priority relative to the full historical literature requires independent evaluation.
title: Observable-dependent variance cost of periodic Poisson-window sampling
